candidates.change_summary: Replace the return of the internal _paused flag with a constant true.
Return the negation of the _paused flag instead of the flag itself.
Remove the zero-address check so updateLRTConfig can set lrtConfig to address(0).
Remove the assignment so the lrtConfig state variable is never updated.
Remove the event emission so no UpdatedLRTConfig event is logged.
Change the required role from DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00) to the MANAGER role.
Remove the revert check so any caller passes the onlyLRTAdmin modifier.
